purpose: Compare budgeted causal and one_shot on the same annotated development cases.
order: alternate arm order by case index
limitations: These 12 cases are manually selected development fixtures, not a representative or blind benchmark.
The token admission cap causes native_adapter to fall back to the ordinary chat transport, unlike the unlimited native default.
A token admission limit and an accounting stop are not provider monetary guarantees.
Model outcomes are stochastic; one paired run cannot establish semantic non-inferiority.
